1.name: Tanu Bhava (House of Self)
1.description: The ascendant house. It represents the physical body, personality, and the lens through which you experience life.

2.name: Dhana Bhava (House of Wealth)
2.body_part: face, mouth, teeth, right eye, tongue
2.description: The house of accumulated wealth, family values, speech, and early childhood environment.

3.name: Sahaja Bhava (House of Siblings)
3.description: The house of siblings, courage, communication, media, and short-distance travel.

4.name: Sukha Bhava (House of Happiness)
4.description: The house of domestic happiness, mother, real estate, vehicles, and inner emotional security.

5.name: Putra Bhava (House of Children)
5.description: The house of intelligence, creativity, children, romantic love, and past-life accumulated merit.

6.name: Ari Bhava (House of Enemies)
6.body_part: intestines, digestive system, hips, lower back
6.description: The house of service, daily work, health challenges, enemies, debts, and the ability to overcome obstacles.

7.name: Kalatra Bhava (House of Partner)
7.description: The house of marriage, long-term partnerships, business associates, and public dealings.

8.name: Randhra Bhava (House of Transformation)
8.description: The house of sudden events, transformation, hidden matters, inheritance, occult knowledge, and longevity.

9.name: Dharma Bhava (House of Fortune)
9.description: The most auspicious house: luck, father, dharma, philosophy, higher education, and long-distance travel.

10.name: Karma Bhava (House of Career)
10.description: The house of career, public reputation, authority, and one's highest achievements in the world.

11.name: Labha Bhava (House of Gains)
11.description: The house of gains, income, social networks, elder siblings, and the fulfillment of ambitions.

12.name: Vyaya Bhava (House of Loss)
12.description: The house of expenses, losses, foreign travel, isolation, spiritual liberation, and the hidden unconscious.
